description: git diff dacf642..wf/crash touches elixir/to_lean.exs (+139/-22 in b69d423), elixir/src/watchdog.ex, Leanactors/Gen/Watchdog.lean, Leanactors/Examples/Watchdog.lean (comment block only in final state). Ctx struct gains mods: [] and kinds: %{}. render_clauses now returns insert_crashes(ctx, rendered) where rendered is a list of {clause, total?, string} triples instead of strings, so any other branch that changes render_clauses' map_reduce body must keep the triple shape; clauses/2 itself is unchanged except clause_of/5 adding the :kind field to the clause map (any branch pattern-matching clause maps by full shape must add kind). sends/3 and plain_body are not touched by this branch. Header comment additions: new paragraph 'Unhandled messages (effects mode only)' in to_lean.exs and a new 'unhandled messages' bullet in watchdog.ex's header; both are likely textual conflict points with the init (task.ex), sysprops (supervisor.ex) and receive pieces.
